explication: This repository combines an open Ziwei Doushu chart engine and reference datasets with a minimal Next.js demo. The main user flow is entering birth details, producing a chart, then viewing its palaces and time-period views. README capabilities also include classical-text search and a star-and-topic knowledge library. The chart page and some engine wiring were not sampled, so those connections reflect documented behavior; the demo has no included backend API, and its interpretation helper is explicitly a placeholder.
